title: One Fungus Has Hit 501 Amphibian Species
hook: The deadliest wildlife disease is still pushing amphibians backward.
closing: The fungus caused a mass die-off, and many surviving species are still losing ground.
question: Which frog would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus affected 501 amphibian species. Its toll spans extinctions and hundreds of surviving populations.
About 39% of affected species are still declining. Survival has not meant recovery.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. One country's toll shows how broadly the disease reaches.
